title: MEIKO — The Scales Of Justice〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: What lies behind. What lies ahead.

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have nothing more to say.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey...!
MEIKO, wait!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What did you mean by that?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Looks like she's left...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I really wasn't planning on telling her so much...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sometimes, talking can make things worse.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why are you so obsessed with helping Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why? Because...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because we're friends!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But she seemed desperate and unwilling to leave unless I told her something.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (And if I didn't, a certain someone would likely have tried to butt in...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Originally, I was hoping to just hear what Ena had to say while not actually telling her anything...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ah, I see that Ena's left already.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, it's you...
I'm guessing that you saw everything.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Of course.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And all things considered, MEIKO, you seemed to enjoy having that little chat with her.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I just gave her some advice because I thought she'd be better off hearing it from me as opposed to you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I don't bite... Hard...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Says you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If I decided not to talk to Ena, you would've gone to talk to her, no?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And you would've ruffled her feathers like you did with Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She's looking for a solution to her problem, yes? It's our job to help her along the way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Again, says you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But to be completely honest, I believe either of us would have sufficed...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Either of us...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I certainly would've tried speaking to Ena if you decided to keep your distance.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: However, you were willing to make an exception for her and decided to give her some advice yourself...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It didn't matter which of us spoke to her. The end result would've been the same...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. But I enjoyed seeing this side of you for a change.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And now, instead of Ena, you're trying to ruffle my feathers.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How long have you been planning to do this...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Just a little while ago when I noticed that Ena was looking for you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And I wasn't “planning” anything, so don't worry.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That isn't very reassuring...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We really are incompatible with one another...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, is that so?
I think we're getting along just fine.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Our conversations are always so stimulating, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Go talk to Rin if you want that.
I'll be going now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll talk again soon.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What in the world is she planning?
